summary: A card points at a workspace file that does not exist (reported only when the host lends files and says so).
A picture's bytes are not in the board, so it shows as a placeholder.
A connector end is attached to an element that is gone, on another page, or cannot take connectors (or was, in the file, until opening detached it).
A board card's path now holds another board than the one it was made for (the docId it stored differs from the file's).
A shape's label does not fit the part of its shape a label may use, with the engine's fonts.
A flow-chart node has no connector while the page holds other flow-chart nodes.
A flow-chart or mind-map node has no label.
An element reaches outside the frame that holds it.
A connector's route runs through a shape that is neither of its ends.
